rules.title: Rules
rules.boardText: Each player has 9 pits (uya) and a kazan for captured korgools. Every pit starts with 9 korgools, 162 in total.
rules.sowText: Take every korgool from one of your pits and sow them one by one counter-clockwise, starting with the same pit. A single korgool moves to the next pit.
rules.sowCaption: Four korgools from pit 7: into pits 7, 8, 9 and the opponent's pit 1.
rules.captureText: If your last korgool lands on the opponent's side and makes an even number, every korgool in that pit goes to your kazan.
rules.captureCaption: The opponent's pit 2 now holds 6 — all six go to your kazan.
rules.tuzdykText: If your last korgool makes exactly 3 in an opponent's pit, it becomes your tuzdyk for good: everything that lands there is yours. One tuzdyk per game; never in pit 9, and not in the pit with the same number as the opponent's tuzdyk.
rules.tuzdykCaption: The opponent's pit 1 is now your tuzdyk.
rules.winText: The first to collect 82 korgools wins. 81 : 81 is a draw. If a player cannot move, the opponent collects the korgools left on their own side.
tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.tapPitSub: The korgools will be sown one by one counter-clockwise, starting with this pit.
tutorial.boardText: You and your opponent each have 9 pits with 9 korgools in each. Your pits are at the bottom (on the right on a phone), numbered 1 to 9. Captured korgools go to your kazan. The first to collect 82 wins.
tutorial.sowDone: The last korgool landed in the opponent’s pit 6 and made 10 there. That is even, so all 10 korgools went to your kazan. This is a capture.
tutorial.captureText: Captures can be planned. The eight korgools from pit 4 reach the opponent’s pit 2 and make 6 there.
tutorial.captureDone: Six korgools are in your kazan. With an odd number there would be no capture.
tutorial.tuzdykText: If your last korgool makes exactly 3 in an opponent’s pit, that pit becomes your tuzdyk. The opponent’s pit 3 has 2 now, and the last korgool from pit 5 lands there.
tutorial.tuzdykDone: The opponent’s pit 3 is your tuzdyk until the end of the game. Every korgool that lands in it, whoever moves, goes to your kazan. You get one tuzdyk per game, and never in pit 9.
tutorial.winText: Your kazan has 76. Pit 9 captures the 6 korgools in the opponent’s pit 2, making 82.
tutorial.winDone: 82, you win! At 81 : 81 it is a draw. If a player has no move, the opponent takes the korgools on their own side and the game ends. Now you know all the rules.
